The names come from Unicode CLDR and Wikidata, and a correction there reaches every project that uses them; tell us
here too, and we will carry it until it arrives. `docs/disagreements.md` lists the names where the two sources
differ. Every line of the demo is listed beside its English in `docs/strings-ja.md`.
